title: Grateful Dead Live at Meadowlands Arena on 1983-04-16
source: source: aud cassette master; taped by Doug Lamarre; nakamichi 300/cp4 shotguns > sony d5; maxell xlIIs90’s, dolby b; nakamichi dragon/b > benchmark adc1 @ 24/96 > adobe audition cc > fission > xACT; transferred & seeded - Rob Berger

ai_review.summary: Excellent, bass‑rich recording with nicely balanced mix and fantastic playing, though some spots are rough and rushed.
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises the overall sound as excellent—bassy and well balanced—and highlights the band's fantastic playing. A few moments are described as a bit rough and rushed, but the performance remains highly enjoyable. The recording quality is strong enough to make this a recommended listen.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 5‑star review rates both the show and the recording very highly, with only minor criticism of occasional roughness; limited data lowers confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Bassy, nicely balanced mix; some sections sound a bit rough and rushed.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Fantastic overall playing with occasional rushed spots.
